learning.newBody: From sentence building to conversations: choose a game and your level.

instructions.sentence-builder: Tap tiles to build a sentence. Tap a selected tile to return it. More than one order may be correct.
instructions.collocations: Choose the word that fits the whole sentence, then check your answer.
instructions.grammar-detective: Tap a suspicious word, then rewrite the complete sentence correctly.
instructions.plural: Type the plural with die. Remember noun capitalization and umlauts.
instructions.word-family: Use the root word and context to choose the right noun, verb or adjective.
instructions.dialogue: Read the speaker’s turn and your goal, then choose a fitting response.

learning.adaptiveDescription: Prioritise unseen questions and rules you find difficult. After at least 12 different questions at your selected level, the next round may move up or down one level. You can turn this off at any time.
learning.adaptiveGuest: Guest practice keeps your selected level. Log in to select questions using your recent results and mistakes.
